assessment: Clement et al. described and illustrated the endocasts of six Paleozoic lungfish genera from superb 3D fossil material, which are very informative for the understanding of brain evolution of lungfishes, the extant sister group to land vertebrates. Rendering important anatomical details regarding brain evolution in lungfishes and conducting a morphometric analysis, this work will be of interest to a broad evolutionary and paleontological audience.
affiliation: Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
